label: “Propose enzyme variants with a redesigned active-site pocket.”
prompt: Propose enzyme variants with a redesigned active-site pocket. (protein design)
answerHead:
BioMate

profam — Protein family-guided active-site redesign with structural constraints and variant scoring.

Input: Protein structure (1LYZ.pdb); candidate sequences (enzyme_candidates.fasta); active-site constraints (enzyme_constraints.json)
Key steps:
Structure parsing & constraint validation — map catalytic residues (Glu35, Asp52) and disulfide bonds from PDB
Sequence alignment & homology modeling — rank candidates against template; evaluate pocket geometry
Scoring & stability prediction — AlphaFold2-based pLDDT confidence + FoldX ΔΔG estimates for thermostability
Expected output: Ranked variant list (CSV with sequence ID, predicted ΔΔG, pLDDT, constraint violations); structure alignments (PDB); confidence report (JSON)

Note: This workflow does not directly use your attached PDB or FASTA files as streaming inputs — it is configured through its parameter panel. If you need a workflow that reads your structure and designs new sequences de novo (rather than scoring pre-computed candidates), a complementary ProteinMPNN or Rosetta-based design workflow would be better suited; I can search for that if needed.

Review the parameters in the panel and confirm execution when ready.

profam
